description.p: This is a community package of BenchUp, maintained independently and unaffiliated with BenchUp. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
BenchUp is a 3D modeler for woodworking. Draw parts, join them, and keep a project in a local file. No account is required.
Sandbox: display and GPU. Files are opened and saved through the file chooser. The in-app updater is not available in this package. Updates come through FlatPark.

Sharing a project with your own server needs a network grant: flatpak override --user --share=network io.github.BenchUp3D.BenchUp, then start BenchUp with --server-url=URL or set BENCHUP_SERVER_URL. A 3D mouse is read through /dev/hidraw, which needs flatpak override --user --device=all io.github.BenchUp3D.BenchUp.
